newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Most grain, soybean values flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Most grain, soybean values flat.

text.p: Grain and soybean FOB values were mostly unchanged Tuesday in what most dealers described as very quiet markets.
"It's been very, very quiet," a Kansas City-based dealer said.
The Thanksgiving holiday on Thursday has dampened enthusiasm for trade in most grain markets, cash sources said.
The market was supported by ideas that the pace of wheat exports from the U.S. will pick up after the holiday lull.
Algeria was expected to tender Friday for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, cash sources said.
Some exporters said the business could go to the U.S.
